name: personal-cc-plugins
description: Development and product workflow plugins for Claude Code — dev lifecycle (launchpad), product lifecycle (tpm), documentation (docs), commit quality (commit), and feedback-to-engineering triage (feedback-triage)

plugins.name: launchpad
plugins.description: Dev lifecycle — /stage, /mission-plan, /launch, /orbit, /land; Iron-Law flight rules and hook-enforced validation stamp

plugins.name: tpm
plugins.description: Product lifecycle — /feedback, /triage, /roadmap, /spec, /comms for TPMs and OSS maintainers

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Documentation management — /docs plus the writing-docs skill with project style override

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Commit quality — intelligent staging and project-convention messages; never pushes unasked

plugins.name: feedback-triage
plugins.description: Feedback triage — /intake GitHub + Slack into a deduplicated queue, /recheck on a loop, /investigate with complexity-gated subagents (findings, options, or a reviewed PR), /report spiciness-rated Slack messages
